t: This is the home ground of Beggars Group, a British record company. Martin Mills founded it and is its chairman. The group owns or holds stakes in a string of well-known labels, including 4AD, Rough Trade Records, Matador Records, XL Recordings and Young. So behind this one name sits a good part of independent music. Mills, born in 1949, is described as a British entrepreneur, and he built the group up from the beginning.
